dict.string: New and improved shortcuts make it easier than ever to automate Budget Flow, including automatically adding transactions from banking app notifications on iOS and iPadOS 27.
On supported devices, Budget Flow can now use Apple Intelligence to determine the category and payee when automatically creating transactions with shortcuts.
Support for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 27
Design refinements and compatibility updates keep Budget Flow running smoothly on the latest Apple operating systems: iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 27.
